name: SOLIZE Group
verdict: Sponsorship concluded by SOLIZE PARTNERS Corporation, a group company of Tokyo-listed SOLIZE Holdings. Nothing found.
note: SOLIZE Holdings' largest shareholder (21%) is its employee stock-ownership association; a 5.6% holder, Tokyo Small and Medium Business Investment & Development Co., Ltd., is a government-affiliated Japanese investment company, but Japan has no sourced record of serious abuses under METHOD.md.
